facts.text: I work for a label.
I want to use a GCP bucket to upload various files containing literature on music artists.
I want to fine-tune GPT-3 eventually to write marketing copy.
I will save the uploaded files as PDFs, Word documents, text files, and jpegs.
I created a GCP bucket.
I want to know whether the bucket is the same as a dataset.
After uploading files, I want to make sure the data is prepared for fine-tuning a GPT-3 model.
I want to use the AutoML tool.
I want alternatives to AutoML.
I want to create a dataset from a bucket containing PDFs, JPEGS, and Word documents.
I want to label the data to make it clear what the document types are.
I want to label which artist each document relates to.
I want to label which release each document relates to.
Some document labeling could be discerned automatically from file names.
Long term, I want to use the structure of the files to show what the files are and what artists they relate to.
I may play around with a small amount of data to get a feel for the tools first.
I may label a small amount of data manually for now.
I want a database that has labels for document type, date published, author, publication, artist, and release.
My document type labels include CD booklet.
My document type labels include Artist biography.
My document type labels include Press article.
My document type labels include Infomail (a company-wide email with info about the release sent by the campaign manager).
